title: Tag chips — stronger contrast, colors fitted to each theme

steps.path: Type /resume, then look at the tags under a conversation's name
steps.headline: Tags stand out more: bolder word, stronger color wash and a clearer outline.
steps.changed: The word uses the theme's main text color instead of the softer one, and the fill and outline are about twice as strong as round 1.
steps.notice: Tags pop off the card on every theme, including the pale ones where round 1 looked washed out.
steps.risk: Tags are now a little louder than the Working label next to them.

steps.path: Click the session name at the top, or hold Shift, and look at the tags under the Working label
steps.headline: Each tag color is now tuned to the theme: lighter on dark themes, deeper on light ones.
steps.changed: Every tag color is blended a quarter of the way toward the theme's text color, so it adapts on its own, community themes included.
steps.notice: Colors sit more naturally in each theme instead of one fixed set everywhere.
